Aircraft.name: Jet Fighter VTOL - Peregrine
Aircraft.Instructions:
Peregrine By: Shizzle Styx
AG1: Opens Canopy AG2: Emergency Jettison AG3: 2D Thrust Vectoring AG4: Control Limiter AG5: Targeting Pod Power AG6: Free AG7: VTOL Stabilisation - to prevent squeaky bum time AG8: RCS Controls
Flaps: Deploys flaps at negative %s Trim: Trims aircraft pitch controls VTOL: Rotates Engine Nozzles
Notes: After the first demo a lot of you asked for a forward-swept wing jet, so I pestered Mod until he sighed "fine" and muttered something about my designs being boring. I could've gone with the usual suspects like the X-29 or Su-47, but if we're doing weird, we're going full bizarre. This thing is based on BAE's P.1214 - a concept which I assume was designed without any adult supervision. Affectionally known as the "X-Wing Fighter", the P.1214 is a direct successor to the Harrier jump jet and perhaps weirdly, arguably a slightly indirect predecessor to the F-35B, of which the 3 bearing swivel nozzle is partially derived from... I could go on about how weird this concept and its engine was, but I can see Mod getting progressively more anxious as I write this.
